context: Add structure-aware handling for requested primary_keys and foreign_keys (including mapping keys and list values), then drive the real companion writer and retain the existing generic secret/path policy.
description: The shipped anonymized .tuning.json path hashes table_tunings keys and column names but leaves requested constraint mappings under tables and their column list verbatim. A driven origin/develop payload retained orders and o_orderkey in the public companion. Extend the tuning-specific anonymizer to cover constraint table and column identifiers while preserving enabled flags, tuning values, normalized source references, and byte-for-byte raw output when anonymize=False.

preserves.behavior: tuning enabled flags and non-identifier tuning values

verifications.command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'import json; from benchbox.core.results.anonymization import AnonymizationManager; out=AnonymizationManager().anonymize_tuning_payload({"requested":{"constraints":{"primary_keys":{"enabled":True,"tables":{"orders":["o_orderkey"]}}},"table_tunings":{"orders":{"name":"o_orderkey"}}}}); text=json.dumps(out); assert "orders" not in text and "o_orderkey" not in text'
verifications.description: public tuning payload contains no raw requested constraint table or column identifiers
verifications.expected: exits 1 on an unfixed tree because requested constraint identifiers remain public; exits 0 after structure-aware tuning anonymization

verifications.description: existing result anonymization and companion tests pass
verifications.expected: passes before and after as a regression guard
